Executive Summary

A whole-school view across learners, resources, and operations

Dashboard Guide

Cabiao National High School KPI & Decision-Support Dashboard

Purpose

This dashboard consolidates selected institutional KPIs to help school administrators monitor performance, identify gaps, compare results against targets, and prioritize areas requiring management attention.

How to Use the Dashboard

  1. Select a dashboard section from the left sidebar, such as Enrollment & Retention, Academic & Attendance, Budget & Finance, Workforce, Programs & Reporting, Stakeholders, or Priority Issues.
  2. Use the School / Fiscal Year and Quarter filters at the top of the page to change the period being analyzed.
  3. Use section-specific filters where available, such as grade level, subject, department, category, or stakeholder group.
  4. Review KPI cards, charts, and tables together. KPI cards provide a quick summary, while charts and tables show trends, comparisons, and areas requiring closer review.
  5. Open Priority Issues to view the most significant performance gaps identified across the dashboard for management attention.

Dashboard Perspectives

  • Student Outcomes — enrollment, retention, attendance, and academic performance.
  • Financial Management — budget utilization, procurement, disbursement, and reporting compliance.
  • Internal Operations — workforce, training, programs, activities, and report submission.
  • Stakeholder Engagement — satisfaction, participation, partnerships, and stakeholder support.

Interpreting Status Indicators

Green
Generally indicates favorable performance or target attainment.
Gold
Generally indicates an area that should be monitored.
Maroon
Generally indicates a performance gap or area requiring attention.

Priority Issues

The Priority Issues section is intended as a decision-support view. It summarizes and ranks notable performance concerns based on the dashboard's KPI results and defined thresholds. Administrators should use these findings together with operational context and validated school records before making final decisions.

Data note: The dashboard uses a research dataset developed for the pilot implementation of the Cabiao National High School KPI Dashboard, covering SY 2023–2024 to SY 2025–2026. The publicly presented data are for academic demonstration and should not be interpreted as official or current CNHS operational records.
